protocol: Unchanged carrier, complete432-image A1 and216-bond H, q<=4 chi2 decoder and ALL neural/free parameters. Reuse known64 controls and saved amplitude Jacobians, NEVER read consumed audits. Compute actual reverse energy gradient by exact transpose of the SAME full-H connection plan, then bounded per-chunk raw-amplitude AD and generator VJP. Two half-cache pullbacks (64 centers per arm) yield full-cache gradient via norm-weighted RAW reverse sums. Complete two-sided gradients for full cache and both halves enter ONE predeclared minimax common-descent rule: minimize squared norm of their convex combination in inverse FULL-cache 2FS+.1I metric; report simplex weights/KKT. This is gradient-only optimizer geometry, not candidate-energy selection. Retain pooled full-gradient SR and half-fit directions as diagnostics ONLY. Include reverse components outside sampled central-J row space, reported not hidden. Replay gradient dots against ALL previously sealed JVPs. One new64-center common-direction JVP and8 forward-FD centers per arm before ANY proposal.
update_boundary: ONE joint-parameter proposal per arm only if summed two-sided derivative is negative on full cache AND both fixed parity halves. Report individual coherences without falsely requiring both negative; raw speed mismatch is diagnostic, not a fixed rejection. Use linear speed only for max-alpha bracket, then exactly13 actual nonlinear amplitude probes. Match maximum measured FS across full cache, both halves AND all8 individual chains to .01; no assertion all chains have equal distances. Candidate complete-H products must pass unchanged carrier quality envelope on full cache AND both halves. No damping/step/radius search from energies, no new head, fit iteration or capacity/size/ED/GPU change.
audit_boundary: Only if any candidate passes cache quality, draw ONE new common128-record audit at2026100254. Evaluate ALL constructed proposals including cache rejections; no refit. Commit only cache-passing candidates with nonworsening audit point energy, variance<=1.1C, unchanged ESS/carrier-FS constraints AND actual max audit-chain FS<=.01. Report paired95% intervals regardless of point acceptance. Audit used for acceptance but not gradients is explicitly recorded; it is consumed after this gate, not reusable validation. Otherwise final endpoint is EXACT protected parent. Save original parent proposal checkpoint and final gated checkpoint with correct attempted-step counters. Do not release production from finite-sample point gates.
cost_boundary: Per arm64 explicit chunked pullback H centers,64 primal+tangent JVP centers,8 ordinary FD H centers; at most64 forward candidate-H centers and13 amplitude-only distance probes. Across2 arms at most128 pullback+128 JVP+16 FD+128 candidate centers (derivative work not counted as ordinary forward). Conditional fresh audit at most256 residual forward-H centers, immutable-reference bank also counted separately. No fresh training records. Fixed1800s/8GiB per process; no continuation or remote submission.
